query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name') FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_users' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.cluster.name')!='' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Users

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000), INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time, s.fingerprint AS fp,  JSONExtractString(t.labels,'k8s.cluster.name') AS cluster, anyLast(s.value) AS v FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 s INNER JOIN (SELECT fingerprint, any(labels) AS labels FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='blueweave_users' GROUP BY fingerprint) t ON s.fingerprint=t.fingerprint WHERE s.metric_name='blueweave_users' AND $__timeFilter(toDateTime(s.unix_milli/1000)) GROUP BY time, fp, cluster) WHERE cluster IN (${cluster:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Counts each follow, so two people following one account count twice.

panels.description: Requests waiting for a slot. Sustained depth means the concurrency cap is too low for the number of readers.
